description: File version history, not a per-line blame: the commits that changed a file on the history of a commit (like `git log <rev> -- <path>`), newest first, each with sha, commit_id, author, date, summary and status (added/modified/deleted). Renames are not followed. Up to `limit` commits (default 100, max 1000); has_more says there are older ones.

commit.description: List the commits on the history of this commit: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io). Default HEAD.

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

name: git_blame
